## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Milan, Italy. It starts at PIAZZA SANT'AMBROGIO 2.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Not exactly a farmhouse, but not exactly a palace, Casa Macchi encapsulates the lifestyle of a typical bourgeois family living in Morazzone on the outskirts of Milan.
>
> As if trapped in time, Casa Macchi showcases the decor, furniture, and customs of traditional Italian families of 150 years ago.
>
> While often overlooked in favor of more grand venues, Casa Macchi is an understated, but no less elegant, venue that honors the people and places of the Lombardy region.
>
> Find out how the ambitious middle-class lived at this stunning location and surround yourself with the local history and culture.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €11.25. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 5 ratings and 3 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
